facts.fact: Organic law no. 2004-63 of 27 July 2004 on the protection of personal data was promulgated, setting the general processing, consent and rights regime; the document's capture note of 3 September 2026 calls it the operative statute with no replacement adopted.
facts.system: Loi organique n° 2004-63 du 27 juillet 2004, portant sur la protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: The law names and defines the national authority for personal data protection (the Instance, INPDP) and gives it the powers to receive declarations and to authorise processing and transfers; the document does not state that it has been constituted.
facts.system: Loi organique n° 2004-63 du 27 juillet 2004, portant sur la protection des données à caractère personnel
